title: Build the TaskFlow API Module
goal: Create a NestJS/Fastify Tasks module and trace one request through the framework pipeline.
steps: Bootstrap Nest with Fastify and verify the listen address/port.
Create TasksModule and register it in AppModule.
Add TasksService and inject it into TasksController.
Add a validation pipe to one route parameter or DTO.
Add a simple guard and interceptor, then log the order in which the request passes them.
Add centralized exception handling for one deliberate error.
Add liveness/readiness endpoints and verify graceful shutdown.
Draw the actual request path based on the logs you observed.
evidence: A clean Git diff or file-tree change
Browser, HTTP, database, test, container, or CI evidence that proves the behavior
One deliberate failure, the evidence you used, and the root-cause fix
A short explanation of why the final responsibility lives in the chosen layer
completion: I can reproduce one key part without the walkthrough.
I can explain one trade-off I deliberately chose.
I can show one failure that my tests, constraints, or runbook now protects against.
